transit.title: The N Judah does not serve Caltrain's 22nd Street station
transit.what_we_found: The requested chain says 'N Judah -> Caltrain station (22nd St)'. SFMTA's N Judah rail terminates/begins at King St & 4th St/Caltrain and the N Bus at Townsend St & 5th St/Caltrain; both are at the San Francisco Caltrain Station, 700 4th St (4th & King). Caltrain's own station pages list 'Muni N-Judah' under the San Francisco station's Transit Connections, and the 22nd Street page does not list the N. The two stations are about 1.3 mi apart along the corridor.
transit.what_we_did: Plans use the SF terminal for boarding and alighting and still publish the 22nd Street times in the same rows for reference. Both are Zone 1, so the fare is unchanged, and every weekday southbound train you board at the terminal also stops at 22nd St 4-5 minutes later (5:00/5:35/6:24/6:30/6:53/7:00/7:24/7:30/7:53/8:00/8:24/8:30 AM).

transit.title: SFMTA service change in effect since Saturday Aug 29 2026
transit.what_we_found: SFMTA's bulletin changes N Judah peak frequency from 10 to 9 minutes. There is no N routing change, but it is the newest published change before the trip date and it means any cached timetable from before Aug 29 is stale.
transit.what_we_did: Re-verified 2026-09-07: the bulletin (9-minute peak) is treated as authoritative; the N Judah route-page frequency table still shows 10 minutes, so re-check on the evening of 9/7. Times were read from the live SFMTA timetable pages for 20260908.

transit.title: SFMTA's own N Bus headway text contradicts its N Bus timetable
transit.what_we_found: The N Judah Bus route page text says weekday 5-6 a.m. service runs at 60-minute headways, while the published N Bus weekday timetable lists trips at 5:07, 5:15, 5:43, 5:58, 6:13, 6:28, 6:43, 6:58, 7:13 and 7:28 a.m. - a 15-minute headway.
transit.what_we_did: The timetable was treated as authoritative because it is the document riders are pointed to for times, and the plan is built around the 5:15 a.m. trip. If SFMTA is really running hourly in that window, the next bus is 5:43 a.m. and the 6:20 a.m. Caltrain is still made (arrives 6:21 a.m.).

transit.title: The two earliest Caltrain southbounds are unreachable from the N Judah corridor
transit.what_we_found: The first weekday southbound departs the SF terminal at 4:55 a.m. (5:00 a.m. at 22nd St) and the second at 5:30 a.m. (5:35 a.m.). The earliest N Bus reaches the station at 5:57 a.m., so the earliest reachable train is the 6:20 a.m. express.
transit.what_we_did: Plan A is built on the 6:20 a.m. express; the 6:25 a.m. local is Plan A2.

transit.title: Caltrain minute-level times were read from the live station tables, not the print PDF
transit.what_we_found: Caltrain's weekday PDF (caltrain.com/media/36422, effective Jan 31 2026) could not be downloaded from this environment (3 failed fetches), so every Caltrain time here comes from the same agency's live per-station schedule tables. Those tables also contain 6XX 'Weekend Local' columns interleaved with weekday 1XX/4XX/5XX columns, and the two grids share minute offsets, so a mis-picked column can look plausible.
transit.what_we_did: Only 1XX Local / 4XX Limited / 5XX Express / 8XX South County Connector columns were used (6XX are weekend-only, and 9/8/2026 is a normal weekday). On 2026-09-07 every Caltrain time was re-read directly from the official live weekday grid and matches: 502 (SF 6:20 AM -> Sunnyvale 7:09 AM), 106 (6:25 AM -> 7:28 AM), 412 (8:48 AM -> 9:43 AM), 131 (Sunnyvale 12:42 PM -> SF 1:46 PM), 133 (1:12 PM -> 2:16 PM), 135 (1:42 PM -> 2:46 PM). Rows stay labelled official-live; still confirm in the trip planner on travel day.

transit.title: 10-minute Caltrain-to-VTA connection on the fastest outbound plan
transit.what_we_found: The 6:20 a.m. express arrives Sunnyvale 7:09 a.m.; the route 55 southbound departs the transit center 12 minutes later at 7:19 a.m. VTA asks riders to be at the stop 5 minutes early, so the effective margin is about 5 minutes, and Caltrain trains do run a few minutes late.
transit.what_we_did: Plan A2 keeps the same Muni trip but takes the 6:25 a.m. local for a 12-minute-plus margin and a later bus (7:40 a.m.), arriving about 28 minutes later.

transit.title: Two Cupertino-side stops are not published timepoints
transit.what_we_found: VTA's route 55 sheet publishes times for timepoints only. Stevens Creek Blvd & De Anza Blvd (W) and McClellan Rd & Felton Way (E) are between timepoints, so 7:36 a.m., 7:57 a.m., 12:06 p.m. and 12:36 p.m. here are interpolated between the adjacent published times.
transit.what_we_did: Marked 'interpolated' in every affected row, with the neighbouring published times shown in the note. Treat as plus or minus 3 minutes.

transit.title: Walk legs are estimates from OpenStreetMap, not agency data
transit.what_we_found: 0.08 mi home-to-stop, 0.2 mi bus-stop-to-station, 0.46 mi Gillick Way to McClellan & Felton, 0.87 mi Stevens Creek & De Anza to Gillick Way, about 200 ft between the Sunnyvale platform and the transit center. The 0.46/0.87 mi figures are routed pedestrian distances from the public Valhalla service over OSM data; the rest are straight-line figures at about 3 mph.
transit.what_we_did: Labelled 'estimate'. Re-time them once on foot if you want the totals exact; none of them changes a connection except in the FLAG-6 case.

transit.title: Route 55 has a peak-only variant and one school-dependent trip

The route page also states the 7:26 a.m. southbound operates only when Fremont High School is in session. Monday Sept 7 is Labor Day, so Sunday/holiday service applies that day only.
transit.what_we_did: Return options name the alignment they were read from, and no plan uses the 7:26 a.m. school trip.

transit.title: Transfer credit corrected: $0.50 TO Muni only, not $2.85

A Jan-2026 Reddit thread claiming free regional transfers under Clipper 2.0 contradicts both agencies' current pages and was not used.
transit.what_we_did: Return Muni leg set to $2.35; return Clipper totals $11.00 -> $13.35; cheapest day-total $24.85 -> $27.20. Re-check the Caltrain discounts page on 9/7 in case Clipper 2.0 changes land.

transit.title: Full transit chain re-verified line by line on 2026-09-07 - every number still matches
transit.what_we_found: Re-read the live weekday grid on caltrain.com/schedules/pdfs: SF 6:20 AM (train 502 express) -> Mountain View 7:06 AM -> Sunnyvale 7:09 AM; the 6:25 AM local (106) reaches Sunnyvale 7:28 AM; northbound Sunnyvale 12:12 PM -> SF 1:16 PM, 12:42 PM -> SF 1:46 PM, 1:12 PM -> SF 2:16 PM, 1:42 PM -> SF 2:46 PM. caltrain.com/fares confirms the adult one-way 3-zone fare at $8.50 and the 3-zone day pass at $17.00 (so two one-ways wash), and that the VTA-Caltrain Day Pass adds $7.50 to the Caltrain Day Pass. The VTA route 55 weekday PDF confirms southbound Sunnyvale TC 7:19 AM -> De Anza & Homestead 7:33 AM -> Stelling & Stevens Creek 7:41 AM, and northbound Stelling & Stevens Creek 12:01 PM -> Sunnyvale TC 12:25 PM. The route page stop list also settles why the two legs use different stops: southbound serves 'Stevens Creek & De Anza (W)' while northbound serves 'McClellan & Felton (E)', which is the stop 0.46 mi from 20387 Gillick Way. SFMTA: N Bus inbound Judah St & 19th Ave 5:15 AM -> Townsend St & 5th St/Caltrain 5:53 AM (first trip of the day), N Judah outbound King St & 4th St 1:56 PM -> Judah St & 19th Ave 2:38 PM, single ride $2.85 Clipper/contactless or $3.00 cash. VTA's Labor Day alert ends 09/08/2026 1:00 AM and the Orange Line bus bridge (Sep 2-17) does not touch route 55, so Tuesday runs a normal weekday schedule.
transit.what_we_did: No transit number changed. The recommended outbound and return plans, the fares and the last-workable-train cut-off all stand; this flag records the re-check and its links.

transit.title: Transit fares re-checked 2026-09-07; Caltrain $8.50 now triple-confirmed
transit.what_we_found: SFMTA and VTA official fare pages re-fetched 2026-09-07 (all figures stand). caltrain.com/fares renders its fare table via JavaScript, so the $8.50 adult 3-zone one-way is confirmed four other official ways: (1) the fare formula (base $4.00 + $2.25 per extra zone) prices 3 zones at exactly $8.50; (2) the Dec 4 2025 board deck shows the zone upgrade at $2.25 with the next increase rescheduled from 7/1/2026 to 1/1/2027, and confirms the FY26 structure (Clipper-discount removal, base $4.00) was adopted 11/6/2025 and went live 1/1/2026 (S54); (3) Caltrain's indexed fares-page text prices the adult 3-zone Day Pass at $17.00 (2 x one-way); (4) the Jan 1 2026 elimination of the 55-cent Clipper discount aligned ticket-machine, app, Clipper and contactless prices, so there is no $10 ticket-machine fare (S55). A current third-party mirror of the fare chart (effective 1/1/2026, page updated Aug 2026) shows the same $8.50 / $17.00 / $15.25-max figures (S56, corroboration only). This review corrected a $10.00 ticket-machine claim in the all-cash scenario to $8.50 (cash total $31.00 -> $28.00). Caveat: the Dec 4 2025 board vote adopting the FY27-30 January-1st schedule was not directly confirmed (no minutes found); the conclusion rests on the current fares-page text plus the current tables.
transit.what_we_did: Kept $8.50 / $17.00 / $28.00 cash total; registered S54-S56; re-check the fares page before travel since the table itself is JS-rendered.

lunch.title: Four new rows have disputed or absent TUESDAY lunch service

lunch.title: Business name is not evidence of location - three traps caught in the ninth pass

lunch.what_we_did: The NY/Queens leads were rejected with the links that prove they are out of area; R HaanThai was filed under Fremont; the Union City Hong Kong Restaurant row links to its own pages and states it is not the Palo Alto venue.

lunch.title: Ninth-pass price hygiene: review figures kept out of the price column
lunch.what_we_found: Reviewer-quoted prices for new rows include: Mr. Taco $1-$1.50 (Tue), Mi Lindo $1/$4.99 (own Yelp blurb), Onigilly $15, Harry's Hofbrau ~$20, Kiya $14.99, Texas Roadhouse $9.99 vs $14.99 (conflict), Hula Plate $16.88, Tai Pan $1 sesame balls.
lunch.what_we_did: Per the project rule, prices print only where a restaurant's own menu page showed them. Reviewer/directory figures stay in each row's flag list, so nobody mistakes them for verified menu prices.

lunch.title: Undated event pricing: the Sunnyvale Restaurant Week page publishes lunch prices with no date range
lunch.what_we_found: The Sunnyvale Chamber of Commerce 'Where To Dine' page lists per-restaurant lunch specials (Falafel Flare $16-$25, Empire Armadillo $26.99, Delhi to Kathmandu $11-$18, P.F. Chang's $16.99, Adrestia $35, Meyhouse $39.95 three-course 11:45 AM-2:00 PM, Valley Goat $45 lunch Mon-Fri only). Neither that page nor its 'About' tab states a start or end date, and the uploaded artwork is dated September-November 2025.
lunch.what_we_did: The three rows merged this pass that rely on it (Falafel Flare, Empire Armadillo BBQ & Deli, Delhi to Kathmandu) carry the price AND an explicit 'EVENT DATES UNVERIFIED' flag saying the figure cannot be confirmed as running on 2026-09-08. The prices were not presented as standing menu prices.

link.label: Sunnyvale Chamber of Commerce - Sunnyvale Restaurant Week Where To Dine

lunch.manual_review: Call each venue before relying on the event price; if the chamber publishes a 2026 date range, re-level these rows.

lunch.title: Zaytinya Palo Alto is verified closed for lunch on Tuesdays - rejection upgraded, not dropped

lunch.manual_review: If the trip date moves to Wednesday-Sunday, this row becomes a $40 three-course lunch candidate.

lunch.title: Boda's $5.99 lunch is real but its own site is http-only, so the price is not printed

Willow Glen - weekend blocks duplicated (row since withdrawn, FLAG-35).

lunch.title: Eight Reddit and aggregator lunch prices were recorded and then deliberately not printed
lunch.what_we_found: Pass 11 surfaced cheap-lunch claims from Reddit threads and third-party 'specials' sites: Habit Burger '$10 - half burger, side salad, drink & chicken nuggets'; Red Robin '$10 ... two burger, fries & drink deals' (online pickup only); Olive Garden '$5.99 weekday lunch 11:00 AM-3:00 PM' on olivegardenmenus.net and 'unlimited soup/salad/breadsticks and entree for like 12 bucks' on Reddit; Milpitas Buffet '$19.99' weekday lunch on atly.com and '$20' in a Google review; Sizzler '$5.49-$6.99' on allmenus versus '$14.49+' in its own order feed; Ristorante Don Giovanni '$19.95-$19.99 three-course lunch' inside OpenTable's review summary; Veggie Grill '$10-$15' on Reddit.
lunch.what_we_did: Every one of these is quoted inside the relevant row's lunch_special.includes or flags text, and every one of them leaves price_from / price_to empty. The project prints a price only where the restaurant's own page printed it.

lunch.title: Pass 11 added 59 rows against a 100-row target
lunch.what_we_found: The standing request is 100 new verified rows per search pass. Pass 11 produced 59 (L534-L592): 75 candidates were written to data/incoming/, 14 of them turned out to be restaurants already in the master list under a slightly different name (Home Eat Santa Clara, Tai Pan Dim Sum Fremont, Cam Hung, Tofu Plus, Kabab & Curry's, Tamarine, Ramen Nagi, Pho Nguyen, Desi Dhaba, Sumiya Yakitori, The Sandwich Maker, bb.q Chicken, Asia Village, Masa Sushi Japan), and 2 more were withdrawn on the post-merge audit (FLAG-35).
lunch.what_we_did: The shortfall is reported rather than padded. Every published row has a citable street address and weekly hours; no row was invented to reach a round number, and no price was printed without a page that shows it.
